verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way for users to define or schedule recurring jobs or workflows, such as cron triggers, scheduled edge functions, or recurring agent tasks. The only scheduling mention is enterprise "scheduled Deep scans", a built-in security feature rather than user-defined recurring jobs. Edge functions and on-demand Build mode are developer building blocks or one-off actions, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
